decisive_items: TSC1 gene mutation (15 exon c.1690 G > T, p.E564*)
response.rationale: TSC1 mutation plus cardiac rhabdomyoma, depigmented spots, and subcortical tubers are diagnostic of Tuberous Sclerosis Complex; the posterior fossa mass is a secondary SEGA-like lesion, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Cardiac rhabdomyoma is a feature of TSC, not the overall diagnosis.
SEGA is a TSC-associated tumor; the underlying syndrome is TSC.
Depigmented spots are not melanocytic; no evidence of neurocutaneous melanosis.
Histopathology lacks rhabdoid morphology and genetic/clinical context favors TSC.
